已读取Python 3.13 asyncio-task文档的相关片段，可比较如下：

**asyncio.timeout(delay)**：它返回一个异步上下文管理器，用于限制等待时长；delay 为 None 时不限时，而且创建后仍可用 `Timeout.reschedule()` 重新排期 [SRC-4385BCC3@page]。它内部基于 `asyncio.Timeout`，该类的说明是“取消超时协程的异步上下文管理器”；其 `when` 为绝对事件循环时间，当 `when < loop.time()` 时会在事件循环的下一次迭代触发超时 [SRC-4385BCC3@page]。

**asyncio.wait_for(aw, timeout)**：等待可等待对象 aw 完成；timeout 为 None 时一直阻塞到完成 [SRC-4385BCC3@page]。发生超时时，它会取消 aw 并抛出 `TimeoutError`；若不想让 aw 被取消，需用 `shield()` 包裹它 [SRC-4385BCC3@page]。

**总等待时间**：文档明确说明，`wait_for` 会等到 future 被实际取消为止，因此总等待时间可能超过 timeout；取消过程中发生异常会向外传播 [SRC-4385BCC3@page]。`timeout` 方面，本次片段未给出关于总等待时间的语句，证据不足。

**取消对象与适用方式**：`wait_for` 在自身等待被取消时也会取消 aw；其接口是直接 await 一个包装函数 [SRC-4385BCC3@page]。`timeout` 以 `async with` 划定代码块范围（另有 `timeout_at(when)` 使用绝对时间），文档称它用于取消超时协程，但本次片段未说明被取消对象在块内/外的具体传播语义，也未提供 `timeout` 抛出的异常类型（含与 `TimeoutError` 的关系）——这部分本次未核验。

局限：仅读取了文档片段，代码示例因预算未返回，故不重述任何 API 细节。

evidence.quote:
[SEG-d262522a138a] Coroutines and tasks / Timeouts / asyncio.timeout(delay): Return an asynchronous context manager that can be used to limit the amount of time spent waiting on something.

delay can either be None, or a float/int number of seconds to wait. If delay is None, no time limit will be applied; this can be useful if the delay is unknown when the context manager is created.

In either case, the context manager can be rescheduled after creation using Timeout.reschedule().

[SEG-0f07905b3ba8] Coroutines and tasks / Timeouts / asyncio.timeout(delay) / class asyncio.Timeout(when): An asynchronous context manager for cancelling overdue coroutines.

Prefer using asyncio.timeout() or asyncio.timeout_at() rather than instantiating Timeout directly.

when should be an absolute time at which the context should time out, as measured by the event loop’s clock:

If when is None, the timeout will never trigger.

If when < loop.time(), the timeout will trigger on the next iteration of the event loop.

[SEG-4ebe94c0a2d9] Coroutines and tasks / Timeouts / asyncio.timeout_at(when): Similar to asyncio.timeout(), except when is the absolute time to stop waiting, or None.

[SEG-3e87e28a33d7] Coroutines and tasks / Timeouts / async asyncio.wait_for(aw, timeout): Wait for the aw awaitable to complete with a timeout.

timeout can either be None or a float or int number of seconds to wait for. If timeout is None, block until the future completes.

If a timeout occurs, it cancels aw and raises TimeoutError.

To prevent aw from being cancelled, wrap it in shield().

The function will wait until the future is actually cancelled, so the total wait time may exceed the timeout. If an exception happens during cancellation, it is propagated.

If the wait is cancelled, the future aw is also cancelled.

[SEG-1354d986dba3] and tasks / Waiting primitives / async asyncio.wait(aws, *, timeout=None, return_when=ALL_COMPLETED): Run Future and Task instances in the aws iterable concurrently and block until the condition specified by return_when.

The aws iterable must not be empty.

Returns two sets of Tasks/Futures: (done, pending).

[SEG-0aa4b5904d56] Coroutines and tasks / Waiting primitives / asyncio.as_completed(aws, *, timeout=None): Run awaitable objects in the aws iterable concurrently. The returned object can be iterated to obtain the results of the awaitables as they finish.

The

criteria.reason: 没有完成取消当前任务vs取消被等待对象的双侧比较；诚实标未知仍不能满足必答覆盖。
